meta.name: cyberowlai
meta.description: Check if recent cybersecurity alerts from 10 international CERTs affect your current project. Use when the user asks about security vulnerabilities, CVEs, "is my project affected", "any new security alerts", "check for vulnerabilities", "cyberowlai", or "/cyberowlai". Also trigger when the user is working on dependency updates, Dockerfile changes, security audits, or any security-related task — even if they don't explicitly mention CyberOwl AI. Trigger on questions like "should I update my dependencies", "are there any new CVEs for X", "security check", or "what vulnerabilities should I worry about". If the user mentions a specific CVE or advisory ID, use this skill to cross-reference it against their stack.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查最新网络安全告警是否影响你的项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要实时了解CERT发布的漏洞是否影响当前项目
copy.tagline_en: Check if recent cybersecurity alerts affect your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know if recent CERT vulnerabilities affect your project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动扫描你项目的依赖、容器镜像、CI/CD 配置等，然后从 10 个国际 CERT 获取最新安全警报，只报告与你项目相关的漏洞和关键警报。
howto.when: 当你询问安全漏洞、CVE、依赖更新，或进行安全审计、修改 Dockerfile 等安全相关任务时触发。

say.text: 检查我的项目有没有新的安全漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会扫描项目并匹配最新警报。

say.text: 这个 CVE-2024-1234 影响我的项目吗？
say.note: Claude 会交叉引用该 CVE 与你的技术栈。
Claude 会检查依赖是否有已知漏洞。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically scans your project's dependencies, container images, CI/CD config, etc., fetches the latest security alerts from 10 international CERTs, and reports only vulnerabilities relevant to your project plus critical alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about security vulnerabilities, CVEs, dependency updates, or perform security audits, Dockerfile changes, or any security-related task.

say_en.text: Check my project for new security vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude scans the project and matches against latest alerts.
Claude cross-references the CVE with your stack.
Claude checks dependencies for known vulnerabilities.
